summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by OceanPal Inc., a foreign private issuer, announcing its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders to be held on June 16, 2026. The filing includes a press release, notice of meeting, proxy statement, and proxy card. It sets the record date as May 8, 2026, and provides meeting logistics. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes. This is a standard annual meeting notice with no transformative corporate event.
